title: The Best Writing Starter 2 Sentence Scramble

units.name: Unit 01: Fun at the Playground
sentences: We play on the monkey bars.
Fred and Rachel can swing from bar to bar.
But I can't swing from bar to bar.
I can't climb up the slide.
Rachel can't stand on the jungle gym.
Fred can't stand on the swing.
Olivia can stand on the swing.
Tom and Lily can hang on the bars.

units.name: Unit 02: Morning Routine
sentences: Every morning, I get up at 7 o'clock.
At 8 o'clock, I'm ready for school.
Lastly, I go to my classroom.

units.name: Unit 03: To My Teacher
sentences: I want to know about you.
Do you like playing mobile games?
Do you live in an apartment?
I'm happy to be in your class.

units.name: Review 01: Secret Santa
sentences: I know a lot about you.
You live near the subway station.
You come to school at 8:45 a.m.

units.name: Unit 04: My Favorite Things
sentences: I'm good at kicking a ball.
I'm good at catching a ball.
I'm good at throwing a ball.

units.name: Unit 05: My Feelings
sentences: Having no friends makes me sad.
Losing a game makes me angry.

units.name: Unit 06: At the Fair
sentences: At the fair, I want to ride a water ride.
I want to watch a parade.
I like to hear its music.
I like to eat churros and cotton candy.
I like to remember the happy time.
I want to drive a bumper car.
I want to buy a balloon.
I want to ride a Ferris wheel.

units.name: Unit 07: My Favorite Places
sentences: I have favorite places at school.
My first favorite place is the cafeteria.
I can have lunch with friends.
My favorite place is the music room.

units.name: Review 02: My Least Favorite Sport
sentences: My least favorite sport is baseball.
I don't like to play baseball.
I'm not good at hitting a ball.
My second least favorite sport is tennis.
I don't like sports that much.
